name: cavelon
description: Build, seed, test and improve Cavelon solutions from a repository: the Cavelon skills and the cavelon MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Build, seed, test and improve Cavelon solutions from a git repository instead of the Admin. The skills carry the development loop (validate, apply, seed, test, trace), package authoring, testing and long-running work; the cavelon MCP server runs the cavelon CLI's commands as tools against your instance, with your own login.
defaultPrompt: Build a Cavelon solution in this folder that answers support questions from our FAQ
